sources.correlation_scope: global model version and aircraft family
sources.nominal: OpenAP 2.6.0 FuelFlow.enroute
sources.range: 30.3% of flights on OpenAP's generic fuel branch; of those, 29.33 points carry a calibration factor and 1.01% carry none. Group-median contrast D between generic and own-model flights ranges 4.4974 points across distance bands and 4.3325 across real-minus-baseline altitude bands, with sign changes on both.
sources.evidence: requirements-lab.lock and pipeline/emissions.py
sources.propagation: cross-model or version scenario; never independent noise per flight
sources.notes: A shared model error may cancel in the gap while remaining large in absolute tonnes. Methodology audit Phase 0, commit 62d1fd3, verdict DRIFTING on both axes against a registered 0.5-point flatness threshold. This does NOT prove a non-multiplicative error: D mixes model error with genuine fleet and mission differences. It establishes that the frozen data cannot exclude one. Confounded with the baseline-ceiling defect on BOTH axes, since generic-branch types skew widebody and widebodies fly long. Closing it requires recomputing fuel under an alternative model, i.e. re-running trajectories.

The converse is registered with it: the ranking therefore receives NO benefit from the calibration either, and carries the uncorrected fuel-model error, including k=1.6004 on the 11.64% of flights flown by A20N.

sources.propagation: exact aggregate attrition; nested internal stress; one-day separate-source mask contrasts propagated at half, one and twice magnitude with first-pass CO2 exposure weights; provider-neutral 2,279-flight held-out tranche for separate mask contrasts; full independent-proxy estimator remains blocked until complete suitable external outcomes exist
sources.notes: The denominator begins after complete-flight reconstruction and successful modelling. Retention and the within-gate quality gradient are measured, and a 5,000-flight weighted validation sample is frozen outside git. A free OpenSky day shows differential match/quality response and a 4.61-point proxy offset on controls, so its conditional contrasts cannot correct or bound the headline. The central signed mask transfer is -0.014 points only because 96.3% of gross contributions cancel; coverage-only and unresolved-endpoint masks supply 94.4% of the central adverse magnitude. A separate 2,279-flight blinded tranche now targets those masks without altering the canonical design, but it remains conditional on source response and cannot cover rare masks or upstream ingestion. Changing a gate changes the target population and must be reported separately from model uncertainty.
